lines.zh: 我顺着草叶的边，一步步挪。
lines.en: I ease along the edge of the grass, step by step.

lines.zh: 这两条腿跑起来不算慢。
lines.en: These two legs can move when I want them to.

lines.zh: 我一边走，一边听夜里的动静。
lines.en: I walk and listen to the sounds of the night.

lines.zh: 我把头压低，省着点力气。
lines.en: I keep my head low and save my strength.
The ground trembles; I pause to read it.

lines.zh: 我踩着枯叶，几乎没声响。
lines.en: I cross the dead leaves almost silently.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我在草木间穿过去。
lines.en: One swing of my tail and I slip through the brush.
I avoid the open ground and keep to the edge.

lines.zh: 这一带的气味，我记住了。
lines.en: I file away the scents of this stretch.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，都把退路记下。
lines.en: With every step I note a way back.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，因为我在想事。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I am thinking.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖先落地，再落脚掌。
lines.en: My toe claws touch down before the sole.

lines.zh: 我抬头看一眼天色，继续走。
lines.en: I check the sky and walk on.
The night road is long; I am in no hurry.
I keep my eyes open and stay perfectly still.
The darker it gets, the more awake I am.
These eyes serve me best at night.

lines.zh: 我盘算着，今晚先咬谁的脚踝。
lines.en: I am working out whose ankle I bite first tonight.

lines.zh: 我把头歪向声音来的一边。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the sound.
I crouch as steady as a stone.
The venom in my mouth is still stored.

lines.zh: 我数着林子里的每一次窸窣。
lines.en: I count every rustle in the trees.
This place is too bright for my liking.
My mind is busier than my body.
I sink my claws into the soil.
The wind drops and everything goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我在等某个笨家伙先动。
lines.en: I am waiting for some fool to move first.

lines.zh: 呼吸放得很轻，别被发现。
lines.en: Breathing shallow so nothing notices me.

lines.zh: 我半蹲着，随时能弹出去。
lines.en: Half-crouched and ready to spring.
Patience is something I have plenty of.
You stand there, and I see all of you.

lines.zh: 你这双眼睛，没我夜里好。
lines.en: Your eyes are not as good as mine at night.

lines.zh: 我从你的靴子看到你的喉咙。
lines.en: I look from your boots up to your throat.

lines.zh: 你脖子上的脉，我看得清。
lines.en: I can see the pulse in your throat.
I hold still to work out the distance.
I can smell that you are afraid.

lines.zh: 你手里那根棍子，未必快。
lines.en: That stick in your hand may not be quick enough.

lines.zh: 你的目光落下，我没有躲开。
lines.en: Your gaze falls on me, and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 这么大个子，肉一定不少。
lines.en: A creature that big must carry some meat.

lines.zh: 你一眨眼，我就往前走一步。
lines.en: Every time you blink, I take a step.

lines.zh: 别以为我小就追不上你。
lines.en: Do not think my size means I cannot catch you.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，让你看清我的牙。
lines.en: I lift my head so you can see my teeth.
You do not carry the smell of night.
I am guessing which way you will back off.
Your heartbeat is getting faster.
This time the one watching is me.
The pain makes me jump!
That blow broke my little plan.
My legs buckle and I nearly fall.
Who hit me? I see you.
It hurts, but I am not dead.
I retreat behind a tree and catch my breath.
I will remember this wound.

lines.zh: 我身上的血，不是白流的。
lines.en: My blood does not spill for nothing.
The pain keeps my jaws from closing.
I tuck one claw up.

lines.zh: 你手里那东西，我闻出来了。
lines.en: I caught the smell of what is in your hand.
When I am hungry, I am not particular.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪过去，不惊着你。
lines.en: I edge closer without startling you.

lines.zh: 我伸长了脖子，却没伸爪。
lines.en: I stretch my neck, but not my claws.
Give me a bite and I will go away.

lines.zh: 这点肉，够我盘算好几步。
lines.en: That meat buys several moves from me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手，一步一晃。
lines.en: I follow your hand with a swaying gait.
I snap it up, quick and exact.
I want more, but I will not say so.

lines.zh: 你喂得动我，就能留住我。
lines.en: Feed me well and you may keep me.
You knocked into me and my legs went slack.
Do not tread on me; I am no bug.

lines.zh: 我侧身一让，你扑了个空。
lines.en: I slip aside and you catch nothing.
My bones are light and will not bear weight.
You charge in, so I give ground.

lines.zh: 我们磕了一下，我稳住脚。
lines.en: We knock together and I plant my feet.
You are heavy. Keep your distance.

lines.zh: 我被你挤到灌木里去了。
lines.en: You have crowded me into the bushes.

lines.zh: 我抬头瞪你一眼，继续走。
lines.en: I glare up at you and walk on.
Move aside; I want through here.
The night is the right time to meet.
We brush our heads together, ear to ear.
Between our own kind, no teeth are needed.
I circle behind it and call softly.
We will guard this clutch together.
It is faster than I am; I chase it half a circle.
I bring it a small scrap of meat.
We crouch together by the roots.
This quiet is only for my own.
Before dawn, we part ways.
A scrap this small is worth taking?
I pick it up in my teeth and weigh it.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我先闻一闻。
lines.en: Something on the ground; I sniff it first.
One bite first, and then we will discuss whose it is.
I carry it behind a tree.
The moment your hand loosened, I had it.
Too hard to bite. I put it back.
I tuck it under the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 这口嚼着香，你还有第二块吗？
lines.en: This one chews nicely. Do you have a second piece?

lines.zh: 嘴里嚼着，眼睛没离开你。
lines.en: Chewing, my eyes never leaving you.
I heard you. I do not need to look.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我数完三下就能咬到。
lines.en: At this range, three counts and my teeth find you.
That twig you snapped was loud.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛已经量好你的脖子。
lines.en: My eyes have measured your throat.

lines.zh: 你转身了，那我就不客气。
lines.en: You turned your back, so I will not be polite.
The night is mine; you are only passing through.
I flatten down and stay silent.
I pick you because you are slow.

lines.zh: 我咬过一口就退，你追不上。
lines.en: I bite once and retreat; you cannot follow.

lines.zh: 毒在牙根，等一下就发作。
lines.en: The venom sits at my tooth roots, waiting.
My little plan is set.
You should not have shown up now.

lines.zh: 那股血腥味，顺着风钻进我鼻孔。
lines.en: That smell of blood comes down the wind into my nostrils.
Then let us start with you.
I circle you. No hurry.
Back to the wall and you have no way out.
I step in; you step back.
I wait for the venom, not for a brawl.

lines.zh: 你举着火，我讨厌那东西。
lines.en: You hold fire; I dislike that.

lines.zh: 同伴在另一侧，你以为只有我？
lines.en: A mate is on your other side. Did you think I was alone?

lines.zh: 你喘成这样，跑不了几步。
lines.en: Breathing like that, you will not run far.
I weave close around your feet.
You cannot hit me; I am too small.
A little longer and you will tire.
I keep my eyes on your calves.
Wherever you run, I already know.
I have more patience than you.
This circle closes tighter.
The light you carry does not reach far.
I sink my teeth into your calf.
I spring, claws first.

lines.zh: 牙里有毒，你慢慢就懂了。
lines.en: There is venom in the bite. You will learn.
I bite and retreat before you can answer.
That one was aimed at your tendon.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从你手背划过去。
lines.en: My claws rake across your hand.

lines.zh: 你抬手挡，我换了个角度。
lines.en: You raise a guard, so I change angle.

lines.zh: 我跳上你的背，抓了一下。
lines.en: I leap onto your back and claw once.
Even a small cut bleeds.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，直到你挣开。
lines.en: I clamp on until you tear free.
The venom is already spreading.
I whip my head and tear.

lines.zh: 你这身皮，比我料想的难咬。
lines.en: Your hide is harder to bite than I expected.
One more bite and it is done.

lines.zh: 我从树影里出来，眼睛先亮。
lines.en: I step out of the tree shadow, eyes first.
Night is just starting. Perfect for me.
There is enough dark here for me.

lines.zh: 谁把我从琥珀里弄出来的？
lines.en: Who pulled me out of the amber?
I land almost without a sound.

lines.zh: 这林子的味道，我一样都不认得。
lines.en: Not one scent in these woods is familiar.
First I find a tree to lean against.
My eyes adjust to the light.
I hear living things not far off.
A new world, a new night.
I swish my tail and test my legs.
With these eyes, the dark does not trouble me.
I smell iron and fire.
Hide first, then look things over.
My small claws press into the mud.

lines.zh: 这林子里，我是最快的那个。
lines.en: In these woods, I am the quickest thing.
I look up and see the moon.
Tonight I will travel far.

lines.zh: 火一燎，我的皮就卷起来。
lines.en: The flame curls my hide back.

lines.zh: 摔下来，我的轻骨头最吃亏。
lines.en: A fall goes hard on my light bones.
Water fills my nostrils and I thrash.

lines.zh: 轰一声，我耳朵到现在还响。
lines.en: One blast and my ears still ring.
Something is stuck in my back.

lines.zh: 我脑子一麻，站都站不稳。
lines.en: My mind goes numb and I cannot stand straight.

lines.zh: 肚子饿得发慌，脚都发飘。
lines.en: Hunger makes me lightheaded and my steps wander.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我整夜都瞎了。
lines.en: The flash left me blind for the whole night.

lines.zh: 我还在往下掉，下面什么都没有。
lines.en: I am still falling and there is nothing below.
